none: PAS LIN-F0E557: Silver Roman finger ring inscribed [T]o[T].
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete Roman silver finger ring dating to the second or third century AD. The bezel is broad, flat and tapers to the hoop. The bezel is worn but in the centre is a small letter 'o' indicating that this ring probably once bore the inscription 'ToT'. The inscription ToT probably refers to the Celtic-god name Toutatis, one of the principal deities of Gaul. Rings bearing the inscription ToT…
